From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@finosync.com>

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Resilience workshop + renewal planning

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick answers during last week's incident call. I wanted to follow up with a concise ask: FinSync's renewal is coming up on 2027-08-15 and the spike in tail latency on 2027-06-25 has increased urgency from our platform and procurement teams. We've attached a short incident summary for context (finosync-incident-summary.pdf).

Can Redwood run a short resiliency workshop (ops + infra + SRE/ME) within the next two weeks so we can:
- review the incident traces and likely root causes,
- get focused mitigation steps (cache strategy, routing, priority lanes), and
- discuss a commercial path to a higher-availability offering ahead of renewal (we're particularly interested in options that reduce tail latency and provide an SLA addendum).

Procurement is also asking for an initial commercial signal (ballpark pricing and whether a pilot of dedicated capacity is feasible prior to renewal). Can you share availability for a 60–90 minute workshop next week?

Appreciate it — Sofia
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Platform Engineering, FinSync Systems
sofia@finosync.com

Hi Sofia — thanks for the summary and the incident PDF. Sorry again for the disruption. We can absolutely run a focused resiliency workshop and provide a concrete commercial path before your renewal. Proposed next steps: 

1) Workshop window: Tue 2027-07-06 11:00–12:30 PT or Thu 2027-07-08 09:00–10:30 PT. Please confirm which works.

2) Prework: If you can share representative traffic traces/sample prompts and two weeks of tail-latency histograms that will help us prioritize root causes. I attached a short prework checklist to make collection easier.

3) Commercial options: We can propose a 30-day Dedicated pilot (prorated) as an interim reliability step + a resilience addendum that elevates uptime guarantees and priority routing. I'll loop in Jonas (serving runtime) and Karthik (pricing & enterprise) — they've helped other customers move from standard hosted to reserved/dedicated with minimal service interruption.

4) Credits: for incidents like this we typically consider a one-time remedial credit while we stabilize; we'll include ranges for that in our proposal.

If you confirm the Jul 6 slot I'll book the room and send a calendar invite with an agenda.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding the thread and documenting a recommended commercial/technical playbook to bring to the Jul 6 workshop. I'll be on the call to own the success plan. Summary and proposed offer below (we should align before the invite goes out):

Summary of customer's asks:
- Immediate runbook & mitigation for tail-latency spikes,
- A pre-renewal path to higher availability (commercial signal requested),
- Compliance attachments for procurement.

Proposed Redwood offer (draft):
- 30-day Dedicated pilot (prorated) to start within 72 hours after the workshop. Ballpark pricing: $12,000/month (prorated to days used) for the pilot scale matching their average token volume; final price to be confirmed after traffic profile review.
- Resilience Addendum:
  * Uptime target: 99.95% monthly availability for covered endpoints.
  * Latency objective: P95 tail latency objective of 75ms for identified critical endpoints; hard SLOs require pilot validation.
  * Remediation: one-time stability credit up to 10% of the monthly invoice if we hit >2 incidents of the same class in a 90-day window.
- Deliverables from the workshop: incident RCA, prioritized mitigations, kernel/batching suggestions, cache and KV strategies, rollout plan for dedicated capacity, and an escalation matrix with contacts.

Action items before workshop (owners):
- Grace: confirm agenda and attendee list (done).
- Jonas: prepare a short runtime deep-dive (20 minutes) and bring telemetry checks.
- Karthik: draft pricing slide with pilot cost bands and a resilience-addendum outline.
- FinSync (Sofia): share traces and the PO-intent PDF; confirm procurement timelines.

I've added a draft resilience addendum to the shared drive and attached a docx for initial redlines (resilience-addendum-draft.docx). Also linking the HubSpot deal for sequencing: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2398.

I'll draft an email to legal to start a short review of the addendum once we have the traffic artifacts. If everyone agrees, I'll send the formal pilot quote and the calendar invite for Jul 6.

Thanks — Monica
